theorem answer : YM.Bid.B11 := by
  intro G C S V A P X _ h _ p H i n d v
  let t : Fin n → C.book.Token := fun j => ⟨d j,v j⟩
  obtain ⟨D,hD⟩ : ∃ D, ∀ j, d j ≤ D := (eventually_all.mpr fun j => eventually_ge_atTop (d j)).exists
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ : ∃ R, ∀ j, ‖v j‖ ≤ R := (eventually_all.mpr fun j => eventually_ge_atTop ‖v j‖).exists
  obtain ⟨K,B,hK,hb⟩ := phase_cap P h D R
  refine ⟨B*n,K^n*(n:ℝ)^(B*n),by positivity,fun r hr hr' x hs => ?_⟩
  have hw : constrained D R (realize t x) := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hu
    exact ⟨hD j,hR j⟩
  have he := hb i (p i) (H.threads i) _ hw r hr hr' (realized_spaced t hs)
  rwa [Table.readAt, show (p i).read x t = _ from (p i).read_eq x d v,
    Spread.radius, show (realize t x).length = n from List.length_ofFn, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_pow, ← mul_assoc] at he

proof_context.conclusion: `OneCap (p i)`: each phase table has the polynomial cap bound |S^xi| <= C r^-A, from the operator norm bound `phase_cap`.

theorem answer : YM.Bid.B10 := by
  intro G L S T P hR hs hp _ h hT n d v j
  let q : Fin n → L.Token := fun i => ⟨d i,v i⟩
  let w : Fin n → S.Tag := S.classTokens ∘ q
  obtain ⟨A,C,hC,H⟩ := capped_tags P h hs hp.toSymmetric hT w j
  refine ⟨A,C,hC,fun r hr hr' x hx => ?_⟩
  have he : (fun y => T.value d y v) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => S.useAt T y w := by
    filter_upwards [(conf_open _).mem_nhds (spaced_conf hr hx)] with y hy
    exact (S.at_project T hp.toSymmetric hR hy q).symm
  rw [(he.iteratedFDeriv ℝ j).eq_of_nhds]
  exact H r hr hr' x hx

proof_context.conclusion: `OneCap` upgrades to `Capped`, the bounds for derivative labels (E7).
